name: BETAFPV F4 1S 5 A · Light
scope: Serial ELRS revision. Classical has four three-contact motor sockets; Light has solder pads only. Bare board without BT2.0 power lead or wire antenna. Nominal 26 mm whoop mounting is represented with opposing holes on the board axes as photographed; not a verified square drilling template.

name: SpeedyBee F405 Mini
scope: FC alone, not the 35 A ESC or full stack. USB-C, underside SH 1.0 mm eight-pin ESC socket; DJI/VTX uses solder pads, not a dedicated socket. Six UART assignments include Bluetooth and ESC telemetry.

name: SpeedyBee F405 V4
scope: FC alone, not the 55 A ESC. USB-C, underside ESC eight-pin and HD VTX six-pin sockets plus microSD slot. Six UART assignments include Bluetooth and ESC telemetry.

name: Holybro Kakute H7 Mini v1.5
scope: FC alone. SH 1.0 mm eight-pin ESC and six-pin VTX sockets. Bare mounting bores 3.6 mm; grommets accept M2/M3. USB shell reconstructed from the pinout illustration; connector subtype is not assigned to a filter. MCU/IMU-only revisions are not separate entries.

name: Holybro Pixhawk 6C · plastic case
scope: Plastic enclosure only; aluminum case shares the published envelope and is not duplicated. Top GH ports include two ten-pin PWM breakout sockets; external breakout boards excluded. USB-C, microSD and two side debug ports. Case fasteners and port offsets reconstructed. Regulated power input up to 6 V; servo rail 0–36 V is not the controller supply.

name: Holybro Pixhawk 6C Mini · Model A (current)
scope: Envelope follows the current mechanical drawing: 54.3 × 39 × 17.5 mm. The store table differs (A: 53.3 × 39 × 16.2; B: 58.3 × 39 × 18.15). Three-row 2.54 mm headers face the end. Eight MAIN and six AUX outputs plus RC IN. Case screw patterns shown in the drawing are not treated as verified through-mount holes. Regulated input up to 6 V, separate from 0–36 V servo rail.
